title: Natural ordinary pullback tensor comparison retaining forward associativity
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism in universe u, R and R′ commutative ring sheaves in universe u+1 on their small pro-etale sites and c:f⁻¹R≅R′ as in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Let L be the identified ordinary module-sheaf pullback. There exists a natural isomorphism ν:tensor_Y⋙L≅(L×L)⋙tensor_X with ν(M,N) equal to the specified ordinary tensor-pullback comparison. Its forward associativity equation is L(α);ν(M,N⊗H);(1⊗ν(N,H)) = ν(M⊗N,H);(ν(M,N)⊗1);α. This uses no flatness or derived hypotheses.

source.place: Tags 03EL and 07A4: naturality and associativity of the ordinary tensor-pullback comparison.

proof.text: Construct the natural isomorphism with Mathlib NatIso.ofComponents from the prescribed binary isomorphisms and their existing naturality equation. Evaluation of its forward components is definitional. The forward associativity equation is the proved ordinary pure-triple pullback associativity, applied to those same components. This retains the naturality and associativity assertions in one proved interface.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleOrdinaryTensorPullbackNaturalComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R' : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ R') :
    let L := proEtaleRingModulePullback f R R' c
    ∃ ν : MonoidalCategory.tensor (proEtaleRingModules Y R) ⋙ L ≅
        (L.prod L) ⋙ MonoidalCategory.tensor (proEtaleRingModules X R'),
      (∀ M N, ν.hom.app (M, N) = (proEtaleOrdinaryTensorPullback f R R' c M N).hom) ∧
      letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
      letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R'
      ∀ M N H : proEtaleRingModules Y R,
        L.map (α_ M N H).hom ≫ ν.hom.app (M, N ⊗ H) ≫
            (𝟙 (L.obj M) ⊗ₘ ν.hom.app (N, H)) =
          ν.hom.app (M ⊗ N, H) ≫ (ν.hom.app (M, N) ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (L.obj H)) ≫
            (α_ (L.obj M) (L.obj N) (L.obj H)).hom
